summary: Quiet residential kerb in St Lucia, houses 12-13 m away on this side.

best_section.where: Ninth Avenue east kerb, past the midpoint before the bend

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes line this side at 12-23 m and more across the road; no bush or open ground.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain kerb on a narrow sealed street; a van fits beside the kerb but there is no verge or pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Quiet local street, little through traffic.
drivers.convention: Few cars parked along it in imagery, so a van would stand out.

flags: Steep overall: 4.7% mean, 9.8% max; best section flat
sun_shade: Mixed tree canopy; trees to the west at the south end give afternoon shade.
